messages.subject: sliderInput with adjustable range: a first pass
parts:
I'm trying to get numbers from two numericInput boxes into the min and max of a sliderInput, so as to make the "range" of the slider adjustable by the user.

My prototype is buggy, it occasionally gets caught in a cycle of reactivity: not sure how to reproduce the phenomenon exactly, but fooling around with it for a minute should trigger the problem.

Also, if a minus sign is entered into a box, the app breaks and returns: Error: non-numeric argument to binary operator. I couldn't work out how to "read" the minus sign:  !(is.numeric(min)) doesn't work if min is equal to "-"

If the user inputs a minimum value greater than a maximum, the slider is reset: radical and there may be a better approach.

Perhaps inserting a pause somewhere to give the user time to enter numbers into the numericInput boxes would be useful.

While the product is very minimal, I've actually spent quite a bit of time experimenting with these aspects, to no avail. Suggestions welcome!
